title: Pay wall for everything
body: I get trying to get your bag but 25 bucks a year for some trivia and if I bought endless on the website it doesn’t mean anything on the app? It seems to have a lot of effort put into it but it’s all wasted since few people will pay that much on a mobile game. In a world full of micro transactions this app is pure greed.

title: Spell check / reoccurring runs
body: This game is fun, but the website version runs significantly better currently. The lack of spell check/ question recognition is incredibly frustrating. I am sure that this is due to the limitations of this version being an app, not a web browser. Still , it is worth critiquing. I bought the full version of this game - I do not recommend doing so in its current state. The runs offered by the full version give you the same few games for each category. This ruins the idea of the game. Instead of the game being about general knowledge, it becomes about memorization. Fix the spell check, reoccurring runs, question recognition, and UI and this will be worth the $25 annual fee. Right now, it is worse than its $5 counterpart found online.
